verdict.rationale: Poke's own docs say it can create tables and charts from descriptions or images of spreadsheets, and can create and deploy websites at yourname.poke.com. These are first-party artifact-creation capabilities, but only a glancing fit for documents, presentations, and exportable files. Missing for 10: document creation (e.g. Word/Docs), presentation/slide creation, iterative editing of a created file, file export/download formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
